LESSON: PLANTS AND ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment
Topic 1.4: Plants and its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Plants and its resources. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants
   In simple words: practise until you can identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Plants and its resources using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Plants and its resources in the examples.
2. Explain Plants and its resources to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Plants and its resources.
4. Show that you can: Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Plants and its resources using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Plants and its resources important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Take photographs of different features plants during the nature walk c) appreciate the rich diversity in
2. Using relevant stimulus materials, learners plants. to be guided to categorize plants according to specified features (edible/non-edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- poisonous)
3. Draw one type of plant and share their work with others.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Identify different types of plants edible, thorny/non-thorny, poisonous/non- plants

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
